dedupe_keys.name: gaez 2015 global gridded crop harvested area production and yield annual and monthly

description: Gridded crop data for about 2015 by crop and irrigation. The Scientific Data paper (published 20 January 2022) says GAEZ+ 2015 gives annual harvested area, production and yield for 26 crops and crop categories, split into irrigated and rainfed production, at 5 arc-minute resolution, built from FAOSTAT and GAEZ version 4, plus monthly physical cropland areas using crop rotations, cropping intensity and planting and harvest dates. The annual data are free downloadable GeoTIFFs on Harvard Dataverse (for example doi 10.7910/DVN/KAGRFI for harvested area) and the monthly data are on GeoHub; the paper is CC BY 4.0 and a CC0 waiver applies to its metadata. Coverage is global. Caveats: it is a single reference year. For simulation it gives irrigated and rainfed crop areas by month, useful for hydrology and for estimating crop exposure to drought or floods in a given season. A related catalogue record is the FAO GAEZ agro-ecological zones.
